# handback_artifact_tool

> Hand a produced video artifact back to the tenant that requested it, transferring OWNERSHIP (the file becomes owned by the requesting tenant).

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=handback_artifact_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Hand a produced video artifact back to the tenant that requested it, transferring
OWNERSHIP (the file becomes owned by the requesting tenant). Root-tenant Video-Producer
use only. Scoped to a video_render_request event: the file is re-owned by that event's
tenant and attached to the event.

REQUIRED: build the request's artifacts in that request's staging directory —
"/render/<render_request_id>" — when you create them. Only a file already sitting
there can be handed back for that request; anything else is refused.

Params: render_request_id (the video_render_request BizTxnEvent id), file_id (the
produced LlmFile, in /render/<render_request_id>), role ("app_map" | "storyboard" |
"video"), directory (optional destination path in the requester's file tree;
default "/Videos").

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `render_request_id` | integer | yes | The video_render_request BizTxnEvent id. |
| `file_id` | integer | yes | The produced LlmFile id (in the root producer tenant). |
| `role` | string | no | app_map \| storyboard \| video. |
| `directory` | string | no | Destination path in the requester tree (default "/Videos"). |
